_note: Every value has a source or is explicitly marked as an assumption. Assumptions must be varied in sensitivity analysis, not tuned to the held-out cases.

npci._source: Average ticket is overridden at build time by the official NPCI product-statistics workbook (--npci-xlsx). Values here are a fallback only.
npci._source_shares: Vision IAS summary of NPCI data (UPI at 10)

amount_model._assumption: Lognormal per payment type. P2M sigma fixed; P2P sigma solved so the overall mean matches NPCI average ticket (value/volume).

cohorts._assumption_scam_age: Over-weights 60+, consistent with reported senior-citizen losses. Cohort is for Mondrian calibration only and MUST NOT be a scoring feature.

icfd_umbrellas._source: ICFD-31k repository (IJCAI 2026), examples/source_conversations folder names. Taxonomy only; no transcript content used (licence prohibits scam-script generation).

playbook_mix._assumption: Share of scam sessions per playbook.

timing_seconds._assumption: Uniform ranges [low, high]; deliberately wide. Not fitted to held-out cases.

scam_amounts_inr._assumption: Lognormal medians; digital-arrest large transfers exceed UPI caps and are tagged channel=bank_transfer.

_note_size: 50k legit sessions so each age band has >= 1/alpha - 1 = 999 legit sessions in the calibration split (needed to certify alpha = 0.1% per cohort).
_note_scam_size: 3,000 scam sessions gives ~150-250 per playbook in validation, so per-playbook detection rates have usable confidence intervals.
